feature_title: Condition Null/Empty Operators (is_null / is_not_null / is_empty / is_not_empty)

rationale.edition: The changed file list spans both open-source and enterprise-owned paths: OSS backend (src/api/management/src/models/alerts/mod.rs, src/config/src/meta/alerts/mod.rs, src/core/src/alerts/mod.rs, src/core/src/logs/mod.rs, src/infra/src/table/alerts/intermediate.rs, src/api/pipelines/src/request/pipeline.rs) and OSS frontend (web/src/components/**, web/src/utils/**, web/src/plugins/workflows/**), plus enterprise-gated locations (web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/forms/JobFormPage.vue, web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/utils/jobFilter.ts, and o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/llm_evaluations/eval_jobs/scheduler.rs). The enterprise onlineEvals/llm_evaluations paths are the authoritative signal for the enterprise half, so the combined feature is edition 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing — it adds four new unary operators (is_null/is_not_null/is_empty/is_not_empty) to the condition builder UI used by alerts, pipelines, and workflows, hides/clears the value input for those operators, and removes the old empty/null value hint text. No skip marker is present (trigger comment and feature hint are both empty, no tests-added label). A Playwright E2E spec is modified in the diff, which per policy does not auto-skip; it routes to enhance.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The new operators appear in user-facing condition UIs (FilterCondition.vue operator select, pipeline Condition.vue note, workflow WorkflowCondition.vue note), and the value input is conditionally hidden for unary operators — interaction/state changes that need browser verification (operator rendering, value-field hide/clear, validation permitting no value, and saving a condition with a unary operator).
rationale.area: The condition builder UI is shared across alerts, pipelines, and workflows, but the only E2E spec changed in this diff is tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Pipelines/pipeline-conditions.spec.js, and the pipeline Condition node is where the note text and operator select are most directly exercised. The Pipelines area is where the existing sibling E2E coverage lives, so it is the natural home for the enhance route.
rationale.group: The changed spec already runs under the 'Pipelines' testfolder in the CI matrix (the OSS base ci_matrix.json carries pipeline-conditions.spec.js, and the enterprise overlay appends pipelineImport.spec.js to the same 'Pipelines' shard), so the enhanced spec stays in the existing Pipelines group.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies one Playwright E2E spec, tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Pipelines/pipeline-conditions.spec.js, but only to update the guideline-note assertions (the ''/null hints are removed and replaced with the 'custom column' and 'If conditions are not met' copy). It does not add coverage for the new is_null/is_empty operators themselves, so the Architect should extend it. The many changed Vitest unit specs (QueryConfig.schema.spec.ts, ConditionBuilder.spec.ts, WorkflowCondition.spec.ts, conditionsFormatter.spec.ts, alertDataTransforms.spec.ts, conditionPreview.spec.ts, jobFilter.spec.ts) are unit tests, not E2E coverage.
